'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Vinay Bhasker LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Vinay Bhasker]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Vinay
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
